ITEM.PTXT: A staked type fixing method is used for the axle hub nut. This ensures fastening performance, prevents abnormal noise from the axle, reduces the number of parts and improves assembly workability. In addition, using a 12-point nut equalizes the surface pressure on the nut seat and ensures excellent fastening performance.

HINT.PTXT: The axle hub nut is a non-reusable part because it is staked and surface treated to stabilize the friction coefficient. In addition, when removing the nut, completely release the staked part before loosening the nut so as not to damage the threads of the drive shaft.
